{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma2oa
|version1= 1.50

|game2= tkoh
|version2= 1.00

|game3= arma3
|version3= 0.50

|gr1= Scenes

|descr= Records movement data of input unit over a specified period of time. Simplified.
Pressing the {{Controls|Esc}} key, the duration ending, or the unit dying ends the recording.

|s1= [unit, duration, FPS, firing, startTime] spawn [[BIS_fnc_unitCaptureSimple]]

|p1= unit: [[Object]] - unit to capture movement data from

|p2= duration: [[Array]] - duration to capture for

|p3= FPS: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 20) frames recorded per second (default 20). Limit is 1 - 100

|p4= firing: [[Boolean]] - (Optional, default [[false]])  if [[true]], will record the input unit's weapon fire data as well

|p5= startTime: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 0) starting time offset for the frame time

|r1= [[Script Handle]]
{{Feature|informative|
{{Link|copyToClipboard|Copies to clipboard}} an [[Array]] of [[Array]]s in format [frameTime, unitPosition, unitDirection] for each frame.
}}

|exec= spawn

|x1= <sqf>[BIS_Vehicle, 50, 30, true, 10] spawn BIS_fnc_unitCaptureSimple;</sqf>

|seealso= [[BIS_fnc_unitCaptureFiring]] [[BIS_fnc_unitPlaySimple]] [[BIS_fnc_unitPlayFiring]] [[BIS_fnc_unitCapture]] [[BIS_fnc_unitPlay]]
